laravel_adaptation.catalog_scope: global product plan catalog by schema; tenant is the authenticated administration context, not caller-owned plan data

runtime_path: web middleware provides session and CSRF validation for the HTML mutation routes
auth rejects guests before controller execution
tenant.context resolves the active route tenant from server-side membership
TenantAuthorizer requires settings.manage and controller rechecks the resolved tenant slug
controller validates source-equivalent plan fields and prohibits caller tenant, actor, provider, entitlement and plan ownership fields
create derives immutable normalized code and update cannot change code
global BillingPlan direct ID is looked up only after tenant and permission checks; unknown direct IDs return 404

retry_and_cancellation.cancellation: not applicable: synchronous local database mutation with no queued or external side effect

server-derived actor identity and prohibited caller identity/tenant fields
